notes: The central story mechanic is the cricket trying and failing to chirp (rub wings) until the final page when it succeeds — 'chirp', 'quiet', 'loud', and 'rub' are essential for retelling. The book features a parade of insects (locust, praying mantis, worm, cicada, bumblebee, dragonfly, spittlebug, luna moth, fireflies) but only 'firefly' is included as the most visually memorable secondary character and the one present at the climactic chirp. 'Night' and 'moon' are important as the story ends at night. Several insect fringe words (cricket, firefly, moth, praying_mantis, spider, katydid, dragonfly, locust) already exist in activity_images and can be reused on an extended board if desired. The sound chip/audio element of the book (cricket chirping on last page) is a great engagement hook for students — 'sound' from aac_extras is also relevant.
